claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings are complementary to TF-IDF citation hybrids for non-jurist-preference views: (1) Citation Heritage Recovery — center_projected_64dim AUC 0.79-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74, minimal scale 21yr/137k; (2) Section Cross-Lingual Hierarchy — Sachverhalt cross_lang_same_branch=0.282 > 0.2, Dispositiv=0.150 > 0.1, Erwaegungen=0.094 < 0.1 (1K sample, full corpus BLOCKED); (3) Linear Hybrid Complement — PASS adversarial at 19yr+ (w=0.3-0.4) but JP 0.61-0.67 < TF-IDF 0.78-0.79. TF-IDF citation hybrids remain PRIMARY for jurist preference (JP 0.78). Full 174k evaluation blocked on corpus lane (bge_/bger_ ID mapping, missing parquet 2022-2026, section extraction).
evidence_summary: Three complementary modes validated at max available scale (22yr/144k): (1) Citation heritage AUC 0.79-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74, minimal scale 21yr/137k with 100+ citation pairs; (2) Section cross-lingual: Sachverhalt 0.282 > 0.2 PASS, Dispositiv 0.150 > 0.1 PASS, Erwaegungen 0.094 < 0.1 FAIL (1K sample, center_projected_64dim); (3) Linear hybrids PASS both adversarial gates at 19yr+ (w=0.3-0.4, JP=0.61-0.67) but remain BELOW TF-IDF baseline (JP=0.78-0.79); optimal weight shifts toward semantic at larger scale. Dense embeddings FAIL jurist gate ALL scales (JP 0.05-0.43). True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 target (referenced v8 holdout, not independently verified). Legal TF-IDF from bge_ corpus (6,243 decisions) FAILS 6-8/14 benchmarks vs 14/14 baseline — ALL variants fail citation heritage (AUC~0.5), branch kNN, multilingual invariance, cross-language pairs; root cause: bge_/bger_ ID mapping mismatch, signal coverage deficits. v18 coarse hierarchy negative (best purity 0.65 < 0.7) — referenced file inaccessible. Fundamental blockers confirmed: no bger_ corpus 2000-2019, no bge_/bger_ ID mapping, missing parquet 2022-2026 (29,520 decisions), section extraction not at 174k. Lane correctly BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCIES, continue_recommended=false. Negative results honestly preserved as first-class evidence.
